persona: Mid-level Oracle Fusion HCM functional consultant
resumeText:
Meghana Reddy | Hyderabad | meghana.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Oracle HCM Functional Consultant, Golconda Cloud Partners, Hyderabad (2020 - present)
- Configured Oracle Core HR and Absence Management for a retail client with 9,000 workers across India and the Middle East.
- Set up absence plans, accrual rules and approval workflows in the Oracle HCM Cloud tenant.
- Wrote fast formulas for absence accruals and eligibility and fixed formula errors raised in testing.
- Prepared HDL files to load workers, assignments and salary history during data migration.
- Built OTBI analyses for headcount and leave balances for the HR team.
- Ran design workshops and fit-gap sessions with client HR leads and wrote configuration workbooks.
- Wrote test scripts and supported user acceptance testing and go-live for two releases.
- Tested quarterly updates in Oracle Fusion Cloud and reported regressions to Oracle support.

HR Executive, Charminar Retail, Hyderabad (2017 - 2020)
- Maintained employee records and leave data in the company HRMS.

SKILLS
Oracle HCM Cloud, OTBI, HDL, SQL, Excel

EDUCATION
MBA Human Resources, Osmania University, 2017
